claims.quote: Prompt identification and discontinuation of the causative and suspected drug(s) (within 6 weeks prior to disease onset) are critical.
claims.locator: EAACI position paper on drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) in children (Pediatr Allergy Immunol, 2025)

claims.text: Stop culprit and cross-reactive drugs; ⍉empiric abx, analgesics or any other drugs as much as poss in the acute and subacut phases
claims.quote: Therefore, besides discontinuing the culprit drug(s) and cross‐reactive agents, empiric use of antibiotics, analgesics, or any other drugs should be avoided as much as possible during the acute and subacute phases.
claims.locator: EAACI position paper on drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) in children (Pediatr Allergy Immunol, 2025)
